typography.instructions: Import 'Cairo' and 'Tajawal' from Google Fonts in index.css. Arabic fonts generally need slightly larger base sizes or specific line heights for optical balance.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast adapted for Corporate Blue/Gray (Authority, Clarity, Trust)

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating panels (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`), but prefer flat, bordered cards (`border border-slate-200`) for the primary data-heavy ERP look.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders on cards, inputs, and tables.
visual_enhancers.radius: Small border radius (`rounded-md` or `rounded-lg`) to maintain a serious structural software feel, avoid overly pill-shaped elements except for specific status badges.

components.Sidebar: Fixed RTL aligned (right side). Use `border-l border-slate-200` (or `border-e`). High density, small font (`text-sm`), muted icons.
components.Header: Sticky top, white background, bottom border (`border-b`). Contains global search, user profile, and current active project context.
components.KPI_Card: Flat background, 1px border. Value on top, small descriptive label below. Subtle blue or gray icon aligned to the start/end logically.
components.DataTable: Use Shadcn Table. Dense padding (`py-2 px-3`) for ERP data density. Striped rows optionally. Include sticky header. Add robust filtering/search header above the table.
components.Fast_Purchase_Entry_Form: High-density multi-row grid layout (Bento dense). Inputs should not be huge. Use a dedicated 'live summary' sticky panel showing Subtotal, Discount, VAT, Shipping, Final Total in EGP.
components.Status_Badges: Small pill-shaped spans with soft backgrounds (e.g., green-100 text-green-800 for 'Paid', red-100 text-red-800 for 'Outstanding').

grids.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 for top-level KPIs.
grids.charts_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 for analytical charts.
grids.form_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4. Form fields should span specific columns (e.g. col-span-3 for item name, col-span-2 for quantity).

layouts.shell: Standard Dashboard Shell adapted for RTL. Sidebar on the right, Main content on the left.
layouts.page_container: px-4 md:px-8 py-6 space-y-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto.

motion.hover: Subtle border color darkening or slight bg-color shift (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50).
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements.
motion.toast: Use Sonner, slide in from the bottom-left (due to RTL, bottom-left is the natural reading end).

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to text contrast. Dark slate text on white/gray backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all form inputs and buttons (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none`).

images.description: Modern abstract office atmosphere for empty states or login screens.
Spacious modern interior design suitable for project visual references or headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Inject `dir="rtl" lang="ar"` into the main HTML `<html>` or body tag. The entire layout must flow right-to-left.
All interface text, labels, and placeholders MUST be in Arabic.
Apply `font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif;` globally for headings and `font-family: 'Tajawal', sans-serif;` for body text. Add to index.css and index.html.
Update `tailwind.config.js` to override primary colors to the corporate blue specified in guidelines, and background to a very light slate/gray.
Construct the 'Fast Purchase Entry' form using Shadcn forms and dynamic arrays. It must compute financial totals (Subtotal, VAT, Discount, Shipping) live in EGP.
Use Recharts for the KPI charts (purchases by supplier, projects, monthly trend, payment status). Ensure charts render appropriately in RTL context.
Use Shadcn UI tables for CRUD operations (Suppliers, Items, Projects, Customers, Payments, Purchase Register). Make them dense and searchable.
Include a 'Settings' page with lists management.
Make sure all interactive elements include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='purchase-submit-button'`).
Implement logical spacing (`ps-4`, `me-2`) to avoid layout breaking in RTL.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Opt for asymmetrical or structured grid designs with depth.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; prefer crisp solid colors for data-heavy ERPs to maintain readability.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use a professional library like Lucide React.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings, active states).
Prioritize reusing and customizing Shadcn components located in `frontend/src/components/ui/`.
